name: Adult (Census Income) Dataset
description: A tabular census-derived dataset for predicting whether an individual’s annual income exceeds $50,000, using demographic and employment attributes.
citation: Kohavi, R. (1996). Scaling Up the Accuracy of Naive-Bayes Classifiers: A Decision-Tree Hybrid. Proceedings of the Second International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD-96), 202–207.
